name: codex-mirror
description: Rebuild the canon mirror for a second coding agent (AGENTS.md) after a rules-file version bump: show the changelog delta, write in only the new rules, then enforce the size cap, version stamp, structural anchors, a copy into the shared folder and the linter run. Triggers: "/codex-mirror", "update the codex mirror", "AGENTS.md is stale".
